title: Estimate Implementation Effort
prompt:
Help me estimate the implementation effort for:

Feature/Task: [DESCRIPTION]
Team: [N developers, skill level: junior/mid/senior mix]

## Work Breakdown Structure

Break the work into tasks:

| # | Task | Type | Complexity | Estimate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Task] | [Backend/Frontend/DB/Infra/Testing] | [Low/Med/High] | [hours] |

**Complexity guide:**
- Low: well-understood pattern, similar to existing code
- Medium: some unknowns, requires some design
- High: significant unknowns or first time doing this

## Estimate by Category
| Category | Hours |
|---|---|
| Design / Architecture | |
| Implementation | |
| Unit Testing | |
| Integration Testing | |
| Code Review iterations | |
| Bug fixes post-review | |
| Documentation | |
| Deployment / DevOps | |
| **Total** | |

## Uncertainty Adjustments
- Best case (everything goes smoothly): [N hours]
- Most likely (realistic): [N hours]
- Worst case (major unknowns materialize): [N hours]

## Risks That Could Blow the Estimate
1. [Risk] — could add [N hours]
2. [Risk] — could add [N hours]

## Recommendation
Sprint plan: this fits in [N sprints] if we start with [PRIORITY ORDER]
Dependencies that must be done first: [list]
